headlines.title: 报道：美国考虑设立类似FINRA的监管机构，来审查顶尖AI模型
headlines.summary: 在硅谷领袖抱怨美国近期为放缓尖端AI系统发布而采取的措施过于随意后，特朗普政府正在考虑一项计划，拟在业界的参与下，设立一个独立监管机构来审查人工智能模型的安全性。据知情人士透露，财政部长斯科特·贝森特协助制定了该提案。该提案将创建一个向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）汇报的独立AI监管机构，其模式类似于金融业监管局（FINRA）。该计划目前正由白宫幕僚长Susie Wiles进行审查。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Report: US Considering FINRA-like Regulator to Review Top AI Models
headlines.summary_en: Following complaints from Silicon Valley leaders that US efforts to slow the release of advanced AI systems have been too arbitrary, the Trump administration is considering a plan to create an independent regulatory agency, with industry input, to review AI model safety. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has helped draft the proposal, which would establish an independent AI regulator reporting to the SEC, modeled on FINRA. The plan is currently under review by White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. (Bloomberg).

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi meets with Lesotho Foreign Minister Lejone Mpotjoane
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 18. On July 18, 2026, Wang Yi, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, met in Shanghai with Tso, Foreign Minister of Lesotho, who was attending the World AI Conference. Wang Yi welcomed Tso's visit to China for the conference and to sign the agreement on behalf of the Lesotho government to establish a World AI Cooperation Organization. Wang Yi stated that no country should be left behind in AI development, especially developing countries, which have the legitimate right to enjoy technological progress. China's push to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization aims to enhance the capacity building of Global South countries, enabling all nations to embrace the new technological era, achieve beneficial and ethical AI, and benefit all of humanity. Chinese diplomacy has always adhered to equality among all countries regardless of size. Though China and Lesotho differ in area and scale, they have always been strategic partners of mutual trust and support. China will continue to support Lesotho in safeguarding its sovereignty, security, and development interests, and encourage Chinese companies...

headlines.title: 昨日多只宽基ETF显著放量，高盛称中国股市“国家队”ETF录得15个月最大四日资金流入

headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs' 'National Team' ETF flow tracker shows net inflows of RMB 29 billion from July 13-16, the largest four-session cumulative total since April 2025. At close, the Yi Fund ChiNext ETF, Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF, and ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF all posted daily turnover exceeding RMB 10 billion, at RMB 15.427 billion, RMB 14.649 billion, and RMB 14.287 billion respectively.

headlines.title: 工信部原副部长王江平：建议加大对优质人工智能终端消费的补贴
headlines.summary: “引导高质量的应用，促进消费升级，要探索跨行业、跨领域的合作，促进人工智能终端在智能制造、智慧教育、文旅、视听等领域的垂类示范作用。依托智能化分级等标准体系，加大对优质人工智能终端产品消费的补贴，引导、鼓励消费者采购人工智能终端优品、名品，提高公众的认知度和接受度。”7月17日，2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC2026）开幕，在“人工智能终端产业演进与协同发展”论坛上，全国政协委员、工业和信息化部原副部长王江平围绕“人工智能终端”提出上述建议，他认为，当前正是人工智能终端发展浪潮的一个关键的窗口期，业界人士应该要抓住机遇。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: Former Vice Minister of MIIT Wang Jiangping Suggests Increasing Subsidies for Premium AI Consumer Terminals
headlines.summary_en: 'To guide high-quality applications and promote consumption upgrades, we should explore cross-industry and cross-sector cooperation, promoting the vertical demonstration role of AI terminals in areas such as intelligent manufacturing, smart education, cultural tourism, and audiovisual. Leveraging standard systems like intelligence grading, we should increase subsidies for high-quality AI terminal product consumption, guiding and encouraging consumers to purchase excellent and renowned AI terminal products, raising public awareness and acceptance.' On July 17, at the opening of the 2026 World AI Conference (WAIC 2026), Wang Jiangping, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and former Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, made the above suggestion at the 'AI Terminal Industry Evolution and Collaborative Development' forum. He believes the current period is a critical window for the wave of AI terminal development, and industry players should seize the opportunity. (The Paper)

headlines.summary_en: Panama's Ministry of Economy and Finance said on Friday that the government will acquire the remaining 41% private shares of Petroterminal de Panama, giving the state full ownership of this strategic energy and logistics asset. The move aims to strengthen national control over critical infrastructure.

headlines.summary: 宽基ETF本周被大举买入。Wind数据显示，ETF本周净流入2290.83亿元，宽基ETF贡献最多净流入额，流入1561.28亿元。其中，沪深300、中证1000、科创50的挂钩ETF本周合计净流入额居首，分别为399.84亿元、256.28亿元、196.19亿元。单只产品来看，沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞净流入最多，为214.46亿元，最新规模为995.21亿元，即将重回千亿以上；其次是中证1000ETF南方，净流入139.99亿元；中证500ETF南方也净流入113.68亿元；净流入超百亿的还有创业板ETF易方达、科创50ETF华夏。

headlines.title_en: Broad-based ETFs see net inflows of 156.1 billion yuan in a single week, CSI 300 attracts the most
headlines.summary_en: Broad-based ETFs saw heavy buying this week. Wind data shows that ETFs recorded net inflows of 229.083 billion yuan this week, with broad-based ETFs contributing the most, at 156.128 billion yuan. Among them, ETFs tracking the CSI 300, CSI 1000, and STAR 50 had the highest total net inflows this week, at 39.984 billion yuan, 25.628 billion yuan, and 19.619 billion yuan, respectively. Looking at individual products, the CSI 300 ETF from Huatai-PineBridge had the highest net inflow, at 21.446 billion yuan, with the latest scale reaching 99.521 billion yuan, set to return above the 100 billion yuan mark; followed by the CSI 1000 ETF from China Southern, with net inflows of 13.999 billion yuan; the CSI 500 ETF from China Southern also had net inflows of 11.368 billion yuan; other ETFs with net inflows exceeding 10 billion yuan included the ChiNext ETF from E Fund and the STAR 50 ETF from China Asset Management.

headlines.title: China’s second-quarter GDP growth misses mark, with lowest reading since end of 2022
headlines.summary:
China reported 4.3 per cent gross domestic product growth in the second quarter of 2026 shortly after recording strong, sustained momentum in exports – a contrast underscoring the need for policy support to address weak domestic demand and persistent economic imbalances.
The closely watched GDP figure, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday, was the slowest quarterly growth rate since the end of 2022. The number fell below the 4.48 per cent forecast from economists...

headlines.title_en: National Data Administration: 120,000 high-quality datasets have been built nationwide
headlines.summary_en: According to the National Data Bureau, China continues to increase the supply of high-quality data, having built 120,000 high-quality datasets. As of the end of June this year, the total volume of high-quality datasets in fields such as scientific research, industrial manufacturing, medical and health, and education and teaching across the country exceeded 1,565 petabytes, a growth of over 60% compared to the end of the first quarter. This volume is equivalent to about 547 times the total digital resource volume of the National Library of China, providing strong support for AI development. Meanwhile, China's data annotation industry is accelerating development, effectively supporting the construction of high-quality datasets. As of the end of June this year, the annotation scale in seven pilot cities for data annotation—Chengdu, Sichuan; Shenyang, Liaoning; Hefei, Anhui; Changsha, Hunan; Haikou, Hainan; Baoding, Hebei; and Datong, Shanxi—exceeded 119 petabytes, with 140,000 people employed in data annotation. headlines.title: 四大行提示“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”不实
headlines.summary: 中国工商银行、中国农业银行、中国银行、中国建设银行发布风险提示，提醒金融消费者警惕“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”“固定年化收益5%”等虚假信息。四家银行表示，近期，有不法分子利用第三方互联网平台及社交媒体等渠道，冒用国有商业银行名义，发布“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”“固定年化收益5%”等虚假高息收益广告，并且以此诱导消费者添加微信等联系方式，进而推介境外保险产品或者投资境外平台项目等，牟取高额佣金甚至实施诈骗。经核实，当前不存在此类存款产品，相关宣传均为虚假信息。（广州日报）

headlines.title_en: Big four banks clarify 'deposit 1 million yuan to unlock 5.25% interest' claim is false
headlines.summary_en: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, and China Construction Bank have issued risk warnings, alerting financial consumers to be cautious of false information such as 'deposit 1 million yuan to unlock a 5.25% interest rate' and 'fixed annualized return of 5%.' The four banks stated that recently, criminals have been using third-party internet platforms and social media channels to impersonate state-owned commercial banks, posting false high-yield advertisements like 'deposit 1 million yuan to unlock a 5.25% interest rate' and 'fixed annualized return of 5%.' This lures consumers into adding WeChat or other contact methods, to then recommend overseas insurance products or invest in offshore platform projects, seeking high commissions or even committing fraud. After verification, such deposit products do not currently exist, and all related promotions are false information. (Guangzhou Daily)
